title: USA Basketball "Dream Team" Upcycled Headcover - Driver
body: Handmade in my Portland, Oregon workshop, this red, white, and blue golf headcover is made from a reclaimed vintage USA "Dream Team" basketball jersey. It features marine-grade stitching, and comes pretreated for UV and water protection. The middle structural layer is made from industrial poly, making the entire headcover machine washable. The fleece liner is made from red Polartec 200, the original premium and highly durable fleece. To craft this design, I filled the neck and arm openings with the vertical red stripes with white stars. For a final touch, I repositioned the "USA Basketball" patch from the jersey strap to the center of the headcover. title: Tiger Roar Relief Print
body: The GOAT is now a piece of fine art. Made right here in-house at Matchstick, this linoleum reduction relief print shows Tiger Woods screaming in victory at the Masters. Complete with golf ball dimple accents across the shirt and hat, the multi-block reduction print was brought to life by local Portland artist Audrey Delgado. In a reduction print, each layer of colored ink is laid across a block to form pieces of the final piece. Then the linoleum block is hand-carved by the artist to create the next layer. That means the original block for this piece is now destroyed, and it can never be re-created. And because of the artist's hand registration, each piece is absolutely unique. This is a limited edition series of 15 prints complete with artist signature and sequential numbered edition. Details: Plate: Linoleum relief print, multi-block, reduction InK: Speedball block printing water-soluble ink Paper: pH neutral Japanese Masa paper Paper Size: 10" x 12" Print Size: 7.75" x 9" Total numbered editions: 15 Certificate of authenticity with serial number and date Framed and double matted
